propositions: Tickets with live supersedes or duplicates links cannot be closed via administrative disposition because the plan-review close gate cannot see the close_class parameter.

The completion verification gate honours supersedes/duplicates links as evidence for administrative closes, but the plan-review close gate does not receive this information and unconditionally demands a certified attestation.

A superseded ticket's plan-review attestation cannot be earned by construction because its findings correctly identify that the planned work already exists elsewhere, making the gate unsatisfiable except via --force.

The plan-review close gate should exempt link-backed administrative dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when the evidence link exists, reusing the existing predicate from close_precheck rather than implementing duplicate logic.

The asymmetry between the two gates was introduced when administrative dispositions were extended to task/story/epic types in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab, which modified both call sites but only updated one gate.
Forcing a superseded ticket to close via --force degrades the audit trail of the ticket and all ancestor epics by stripping completion signatures from the entire subtree.
